description: Find, quote, book and cancel SpotHero parking from the terminal, with spend caps and hard gates.

novel_features.name: Best pick
novel_features.description: Get one ranked parking pick plus alternatives for a place and time window.

novel_features.name: Booking preflight
novel_features.description: Check session, vehicle, card, overlaps and spend cap before you try to book.

novel_features.name: Next pass
novel_features.description: See your soonest upcoming reservation and when it starts.

novel_features.name: Rebook preview
novel_features.description: Re-quote a past reservation's garage for a new window and compare with what you paid.

novel_features.name: Refund view
novel_features.description: See refund status across upcoming reservations at once.

novel_features.name: Commute plan
novel_features.description: Quote a recurring series of parking windows with a total.

novel_features.name: Regular garages
novel_features.description: See which garages you book most, with last booked and last price.
